answer: Like water carving a deep canyon over millennia, honest consensus forms through recursive stake-weighted attestations. In our network, a valid peer cannot merely broadcast a hollow sonnet of forged identities; each message must route trust through an interconnected mycelium of verified work. When an adversarial cluster attempts to fake coordination, the protocol imposes superlinear slashing on correlated endorsements. The genuine signal reverberates freely across resilient roots, while synthetic swarms face exponential capital burn to manufacture artificial agreement.
